blindness_confirmation: Reviewed only the Equivalent-Variant Boundary V1 and the four-pair fresh validation supplement disagreement packet; no matcher outputs, predictions, wave-1 counts, candidate strata, other review artifacts, prior gold data, partitions, reports, MEMORY.md, desired class support, or FINAL_HELDOUT were inspected.

reviews.justification: Differential diagnosis and counselling on Amsler-grid self-monitoring are independently scoreable decisions; shared topic and inconsistent benchmark coding do not establish redundancy.
Interpreting abnormal ETCO2 trends and their causes is a specific diagnostic component within the broader task of recognizing ventilation complications.

First-line biopsy or imaging overlaps the broad workup target, but the benchmark's emergency-stabilization stage conflicts with its workup wording, so containment is unsafe without adjudicating that metadata.
Referral overlaps one part of the benchmark, but the benchmark compounds counselling and referral and conflicts in response modality, so it must be decomposed before safe containment.
